findings.summary: Lemma 3.2: The summation index is \(i \in [n]\), but the term being summed, \(|\widetilde{S}_j \setminus S_{j-1}|\), depends on \(j\), not \(i\). This is a clear typo. It should be \( \sum_{j \in [n]} |\widetilde{S}_j \setminus S_{j-1}| \).
findings.explanation: high confidence. The summation index is \(i \in [n]\), but the term being summed, \(|\widetilde{S}_j \setminus S_{j-1}|\), depends on \(j\), not \(i\). This is a clear typo. It should be \( \sum_{j \in [n]} |\widetilde{S}_j \setminus S_{j-1}| \).
